name: Crank It Up

features.name: Marked-spot multipliers
features.description: Repeat wilds on a spot get 2x, 3x, 5x and 10x.

features.name: Additive multipliers
features.description: Multiple wilds on a line add their values.

review:
A funky 5x3 disco with headphones, microphones and shades. Boombox wilds land on reels 2, 3 and 4.

Three golden-record scatters give 10, 15 or 20 free spins, where every wild marks its spot – and another wild landing there gets a growing multiplier: 2x, 3x, 5x, then 10x. Multipliers on the same line add together. The marked spots give the bonus a nice build-up. 96% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
